annotation.title_clean: Folgenabschätzung zur Verordnung über künstliche Intelligenz
annotation.title_en: Impact Assessment of the Regulation on Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (DG CONNECT)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission landing page (German) for the April 2021 impact assessment accompanying the proposed AI Regulation (AI Act). It evaluates the need for action, the objectives and the impacts of policy options for a European AI legal framework. The page links to downloads of the full assessment, its annex and an executive summary.
key_provisions_or_claims: Impact assessment for the first AI initiative: the European legal framework for AI
Assesses the need for action, the objectives and the impacts of different policy options under the Commission's 2020 work programme
Gives access to the full impact assessment, its annex and an executive summary
